metadata.name: crypto.keygen
metadata.description: (kind?) - Tier 1: mint a NON-EXTRACTABLE private key (Ed25519 'sign' default, or P-256 'ecdh' for wrap/unwrap) in the keystore; returns a CryptoKeyHandle (id + public). The private key is never a cel value.

metadata.name: crypto.pubkey
metadata.description: (handle) - the PUBLIC key as a cel-storable base64 string (the keyring's shareable currency).

metadata.name: crypto.sign
metadata.description: (handle, message) - Ed25519 sign; the private key is resolved at the effect site from the keystore, never surfaced. Returns base64 signature.

metadata.name: crypto.verify
metadata.description: (publicKeyB64|handle, message, signatureB64) - Ed25519 verify against a public key; returns boolean.

metadata.name: crypto.decrypt
metadata.description: (dataKeyB64, 'ivB64.cipherB64') - AES-256-GCM decrypt; returns the utf8 plaintext.

metadata.name: crypto.datakey
metadata.description: () - mint a fresh random AES-256-GCM data key (base64 raw bytes) - the per-epoch symmetric key a shared segment wraps to recipients.

metadata.name: crypto.wrap
metadata.description: (myEcdhHandle, recipientPubB64, dataKeyB64) - ECDH P-256 derive + AES-GCM wrap the data key to a recipient; returns 'ivB64.cipherB64'.

metadata.name: crypto.unwrap
metadata.description: (myEcdhHandle, senderPubB64, 'ivB64.cipherB64') - ECDH P-256 unwrap; returns the data key (base64).

metadata.name: crypto.keys
metadata.description: () - list the keyring as handles (public material only; private keys never surface).

metadata.name: crypto.forget
metadata.description: (handle) - drop a key from the keystore (rotation / revoke); returns whether it existed.

metadata.name: crypto.prfAvailable
metadata.description: () - Tier 2 probe: is WebAuthn PRF (passkey) available in this host? (browser-only; false in Bun).

metadata.name: crypto.prfWrapKey
metadata.description: (credentialId?, saltB64?) - Tier 2 SCAFFOLD: derive a wallet-blob wrapping key from a passkey's PRF secret via KDF. Deep integration is a browser e2e follow-up; reports status when PRF is unavailable.

metadata.name: crypto.seedExport
metadata.description: () - Tier 3 RECOVERY ONLY (not login): export a 12-word recovery phrase for account recovery / device migration.

metadata.name: crypto.seedImport
metadata.description: (phrase) - Tier 3 RECOVERY ONLY: validate + import a 12-word recovery phrase (identity re-derivation is the device-migration follow-up).
